ManimGX browser player source provenance
========================================

Upstream project: manimgx
Upstream package: manimgx@0.1.1 (npm), manimgx==0.1.1 (PyPI wheel)
GitHub tag: v0.1.1
GitHub commit: 0507708dc5d731478786de2f46ca8a1660d514d6
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this directory)
Upstream repository: https://github.com/academa-labs/manimgx
Upstream browser source used: browser/src/player.ts, browser/src/director.ts,
browser/src/protocol.ts, browser/src/engine.ts

Vendored and adapted files in this module
-----------------------------------------
- engine/preview-player.ts
  Adapted from browser/src/player.ts. Removed the custom element, source and
  scene ownership, shadow DOM status channel and module-level page singleton.
  Added explicit construction from an already-initialized engine, typed fatal
  error reporting, deterministic dispose, seek/play/pause, and an honest
  first-frame probe.
- engine/director.worker.ts
  Adapted from browser/src/director.ts and its embedded Python RUNNER.
  Added SHA-256 verification of pinned wheels, self-hosted asset only installs,
  CJK font installation before the first `import manimgx`, a build-time copy of
  the native NarrationRuntime, the plays hook and narration WAV attachment,
  one-shot engine handshake, run tokens and typed completion/error messages.
- engine/worker-protocol.ts and engine/engine-types.ts
  Adapted from browser/src/protocol.ts and browser/src/engine.ts, with the
  internal page/worker protocol versioned separately.
- assets and wheels are not vendored into Git. scripts/browser-rendering/
  prepare-assets.mjs downloads fixed versions and verifies fixed SHA-256 digests
  into the ignored frontend/browser-rendering-assets directory.

Version pins
------------
- manimgx wheel: manimgx-0.1.1-cp313-abi3-pyemscripten_2026_0_wasm32.whl
  SHA-256 ef8255890eeaa7281f15afe40c727b5df94199020003f5b698bf18aae94f92ae
- manimgx-fonts: 2026.9.26.post1
- manimgx-fonts-cjk: 2026.9.26.post1 (Noto Sans CJK, OFL-1.1)
- Pyodide: 314.0.7 (emscripten_5_0_3, Python 3.14.2)
- Native narration timing source: src/rendering/manim/narration_runtime.py at
  the repository baseline; copied by the asset preparation script so there is
  one timing implementation, not two.

The ManimGX WebAssembly engine itself is not copied into this repository. It is
loaded at runtime from the SHA-256 verified manimgx wheel by the vendored
worker.

Patched browser engine for clean image output
---------------------------------------------
The pinned wheel's browser engine exports Player/init only and composites the player
face over the film. Browser image mode therefore builds the same upstream crate (tag
v0.1.1, commit 0507708dc5d731478786de2f46ca8a1660d514d6) with a small patch that adds
Player.render_image(width, height). The patch, its source/tool pins and its build
recipe live in scripts/browser-rendering/engine-patch/ and
scripts/browser-rendering/build-engine.mjs. The generated engine.js/engine_bg.wasm are
ignored build outputs, recorded by SHA-256 in the prepared asset manifest, and served
only from the isolated renderer origin. The wheel's embedded engine remains the video
path; no existing video method or native runner/timing source was changed.
